node.label: Neuromyotonia
node.definition: Peripheral nerve hyperexcitability manifesting as spontaneous discharges originating from motor axons or their terminals, lead to overactivity of muscles, typically manifesting as twitches, cramps and stiffness.

evidence.snippet: Neuromyotonia and axonal neuropathy, autosomal recessive: Neuromyotonia (frequency 44/46) [PCS]
